disambiguation: It is an animated graph visualization tool, not a note-taking or knowledge management system.
extras: Works entirely offline. Has a companion script, obsidian-heatmap, for mirroring Notion structure.
intentEvidence: obsidian-heatmap is a Python script, outside Obsidian, that came before this plugin.
problem: The standard graph view lacks a dynamic, visual representation of which notes are most active or frequently edited.

relations.evidence: obsidian-heatmap is a Python script, outside Obsidian, that came before this plugin.

summary: Ember Brain is an animated graph plugin that visualizes vault activity by making active notes glow and pulse based on edit history.
